overallOriginalityCheck: All tasks are new scenarios not used in previous tests. No overlap with forbidden concepts.

tasks.scenario: Helping at a school Open Day – choosing a volunteer role, explaining availability, suggesting an activity, and asking about equipment.
tasks.purpose: Choose a role, explain availability, suggest an activity, and ask for equipment.
requiredContentPoints: Choose a role and say why
Tell Ben what time you can start
Suggest one fun activity for families
Ask for one piece of equipment
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Email from classmate about school Open Day roles. Not similar to any previous test email. Forbidden concepts avoided.

tasks.scenario: School blog inviting articles about learning a practical skill that helps in everyday life.
tasks.purpose: Describe a practical skill, how it was learned, and when it is useful.
requiredContentPoints: When you use it and why it is useful
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Article about a practical skill learned from someone or by yourself. Not about films, places, or generic 'most useful thing'. Forbidden concepts avoided.

tasks.scenario: Finding a large cardboard box on the doorstep with no name on the label – a surprising discovery at home.
tasks.purpose: Continue a story from a surprising discovery – decide whether to open or return the parcel and reveal an explanation.
requiredContentPoints: Decision about opening or returning it
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Story opening about a parcel with no name. Not similar to previous story openings (bus, plane, etc.). Forbidden concepts avoided.
